import torch
import triton
import triton.language as tl

    xnumel = 329280
    xoffset = tl.program_id(0) * XBLOCK
    xindex = xoffset + tl.arange(0, XBLOCK)[:]
    xmask = xindex < xnumel
    x2 = xindex
    x0 = (xindex % 672)
    tmp0 = tl.load(in_out_ptr0 + (x2), xmask, eviction_policy='evict_first')
    scale = tl.load(in_ptr0 + (x0), xmask, eviction_policy='evict_last')
    bf = tl.load(in_ptr1 + (x0), xmask, eviction_policy='evict_last')
    out = tmp0 * scale + bf
    out = tl.maximum(out, tl.full([1], 0.0, tl.float32))
    out = tl.minimum(out, tl.full([1], 6.0, tl.float32))
    tl.store(in_out_ptr0 + (x2), out, xmask, eviction_policy='evict_first')

    arg_0 = inputs[0]
    arg_1 = inputs[1]
    arg_2 = inputs[2]
    arg_3 = inputs[3]

    triton_poi_fused__native_batch_norm_legit_no_training_convolution_hardtanh_35[grid](arg_0, arg_1, arg_2, arg_3, arg_4, 329280, XBLOCK=128)
